ko: 주가 보이신 생명의 길 나 주님과 함께
상한 맘을 드리며 주님 앞에 나아가리
en: The Lord has shown me the way, so I’m walking with Him now He has embraced me when I came to Him with my broken heart

ko: 나의 의로움이 되신 주 그 이름 예수
en: He is my righteousness, Jesus is His name
He is the Way that I take, Jesus is the Name
He alone knows the way I take When He has tried me, I shall come for thas pure gold.
